// SYNTHETIC companion to devbench_source_netlist.spice: the same four branches as a
// Virtuoso createNetlist design section would carry them (spectre dialect, unit spellings
// and `nf` as the real export writes them). A CORRECT same-kit port — every instance keeps
// its name, model, w, l and m.
//
// Instance order is reversed relative to the source on purpose. WHICH isomorphism
// `compare_graphs` returns on these interchangeable branches is not stable run to run, so
// the deterministic statement of issue #216 is the test that supplies the crosswise mapping
// itself; this order just makes the accident likely. Both readings are the same defect: a
// gate that intermittently reports a sizing failure on a port where every device's name,
// model, w, l and m agree exactly.
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
// Library name: xvport_dev
// Cell name: dev_leak
// View name: schematic
MPSTD15 (dp2 gp2 VDD VDD) pmos_lvt l=150.0n w=1.0u m=1 nf=1
MPSTD10 (dp1 gp1 VDD VDD) pmos_lvt l=100.0n w=1.0u m=1 nf=1
MNHVT15 (dn2 gn2 VSS VSS) nmos_lvt l=150.0n w=1.0u m=1 nf=1
MNHVT10 (dn1 gn1 VSS VSS) nmos_lvt l=100.0n w=1.0u m=1 nf=1
